Done. Two files changed, unstaged, no commits.

## Change

**`src/middleware/request-id/request-id.ts`**
- `RequestIdOptions` gains `trustIncoming?: boolean` (`request-id.ts:17`), defaulted to `true` (`:47`), with JSDoc (`:27`).
- Header is only read inside `if (trustIncoming)` (`:51-58`), so `false` never consults the incoming header.
- The trusted-path condition is written as the exact negation of the original rejection check (`!(incomingId.length > limitLength)`), keeping even the `limitLength: NaN` edge case bit-compatible with prior behavior.
- `generator(c)` runs exactly once when no trusted id was accepted (`:60-62`), and `c.set('requestId', …)` plus the response header (`:64-67`) are unchanged — so `false` still exposes the generated value both ways.

## Tests — `src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts:143`

| Mode | Test | Line |
|---|---|---|
| default (`true`) | incoming valid id reused in header + body | `:186` |
| `false` + incoming valid id | ignored; generated id in header + body; generator called once | `:197` |
| `false`, no header | generated id used; called once | `:209` |
| `false` + custom `headerName` | incoming ignored, generated on `Hono-Request-Id`, no `X-Request-Id`; called once | `:220` |
| `false` + `headerName: ''` | generated id via `c.get`, no response header; called once | `:235` |

Generators are `vi.fn()` spies with `mockClear()` in `beforeEach`, so a duplicate-generation regression would fail the `toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)` assertions.
